topic.title: Status bar
topic.para: The Status bar at the bottom of the screen describes commands and displays instructions.

topic.title: Help for the active command
topic.para: You can press the F1 key to get on-line help for the active command.

topic.title: Revise All
topic.para: To quickly revise all the documents in Structure Editor you can use the Revise All command.

topic.title: Save All As
topic.para: To quickly create a new copy of all the documents in Structure Editor you can use the Save All As command.

topic.title: View
topic.para: You can switch between a BOM view and a Parts List view by using the Show View command.

topic.title: Process actions later
topic.para: You can use the Save command to save your changes without processing them so you can process them later.

topic.title: Cache Assistant
topic.para: You can view the files in your local cache by using the Cache Assistant command.

topic.title: Revision Rule
topic.para: You can change the revision rule used to generate the assembly structure by selecting a new revision rule on the revision rule command.

topic.title: Selecting Family Member
topic.para: You can change the Family of Assembly member displayed in Structure Editor by using the Select Family Member command.

topic.title: Where Used
topic.para: You can find where-used documents by selecting a document then selecting the where-used command from the shortcut menu.

topic.title: Setting the action for selected documents
topic.para: If you already have documents selected, you can set the action for all of them by selecting the Save As or Revise commands from the toolbar.

topic.title: Restarting saved actions
topic.para: When you exit Structure Editor you can save your work so you can process them at a later time. You will be asked if you want to process the actions the next time you start Structure Editor.

topic.title: Finding documents to modify
topic.para: You can use the Find and Query Select commands to find the documents you want to modify.

topic.title: Setting properties for new documents
topic.para: You can change property values in the right pane for new items or revisions.

topic.title: Displaying additional properties
topic.para: You can use the Show Properties command to display additional properties.

topic.title: Changing fonts
topic.para: You can use the Fonts shortcut command to change your font, font size, and font color.

topic.title: Keeping new documents checked out
topic.para: To keep new revisions or items checked out, change the closing action to Upload.

topic.title: Assigning new Item IDs and revisions
topic.para: You can quickly assign new Item Id's and Revisions by using the Assign All command.

topic.title: Selecting documents by file type
topic.para: To only see documents of a certain type in Structure Editor, you can use the Select by File Type command.

topic.title: Expand all
topic.para: To see all the documents in the BOM view, you can use the Expand All command.
